reason: I run five buses off Excel, the whiteboard and Xero and it works fine. Two-hundred-odd a month, every month, for software from a company with no customers yet isn't something I'm signing up for off an ad.
objection: Brand new outfit, nobody I know uses it. I'd put all my bookings and driver records in, they fold in a year, and I'm back to the whiteboard having paid for nothing. And Coach Manager or my telematics probably does half of this already for less.
would_change_my_mind: A couple of operators my size I actually know, say from the bus association meeting, telling me it saved them real time, plus a free trial that talks to Xero.
